reviews.text: No bug fixes. I’ve been using this app for quite a while and decided to subscribe. Now for the past year it has been glitching badly. A routine starts and then goes silent. The girl doing the exercise doesn’t move. I reported once and they said they fixed it but nothing happened. I tried again today and the same thing. I don’t know what bugs and fixes they did because I see nothing different. In all the time I’ve had this app it’s never once updated. I emailed them May 4 and they responded on the 14th. $40 per month for this??! I don’t feel like they are doing anything to fix anything but they are gladly taking our money. I absolutely don’t recommend unless they can actually fix this.

Beginner yoga not for beginners!!. Wanted to get back into yoga after several years off and injury. The very first (beginner) lesson was not only way to fast (literally just saying pose after pose) but required literally bending in half and being able to put your head in between your knees. I honestly could cope with that if it were even a little bit slower so I could even think about, say, breathing? There are also no options to slow the video. Idk man anyone know any good apps? 😭

What happened to Simply Yoga?. The app I paid for has disappeared and now asks me for annual subscription. After a vexing hour at 3 am, I tried signing up for the free trial and it doesn’t work! Can’t even see if it possibly could be worth a subscription and can’t find where to complain about being stripped of my prior purchase. Looking for a better yoga app. Very disappointed.

Liked the old version. I liked the simplicity of the older version and the lack of emphasis on fees. Just getting back into this and really just wanted something simple. Yes, users can get to the free routines but they take more clicks.
Updated app. I monitor my activity with the fitness app on my iPhone since the app was upgraded it is not registering on “fitness” it shows as “cross training” not “yoga”
Solid yoga practices. I can always depend on a simple effective and relaxing yoga practice with Simply Yoga.
Recommend 4 anyone!!!. This app helped me and my mom connect and do yoga together. Simply yoga? Simply amazing is more like it!
Requires tracking or locks out. No thanks

Am I missing something?. I have tried both of the apps and they go through the routines WAY too fast. I’ve tried to slow them down but still can not find a way. I thought yoga was supposed to be relaxing. Rushing through the movements defeats the purpose. I find it annoying to pause it each time when I’m in the middle of a pose.

Best 4 beginner +. It’s been out forever, easy to understand good pace, easy for beginners older people people that need to start out at the very minimum level and you can increase from there. They have updated it and added much more value to the pro which I have is worth every penny simple easy effective visualbig fan always have been.

Greatest Home instructions. I love this app and have been using it for 10 years and have told all my friends about it. The instructions are better than any yoga studio I’ve ever attended. My only complaint is the disruptive ads that come after Shavasena (sp?). After doing the whole routine and having a nice Shavasena for five minutes, a blaring obnoxious ad comes on and all the relaxing that you just did, has completely been obliterated. I can’t even relax during Shavasena because I know the ads will be coming on. I wish they would just stop the ads at the end of Shavasena, like they used to, or at least have an option to turn the ads off!!
Love. I really love this session, To the point, it works all that I need to stretch, Thank you🙏Namaste
Gun sales Ad in Yoga website. Just did a session and at the end was shocked to see an ad telling people how to buy guns in Massachusetts! What kind of yoga website supports this kind of advertising!
Great app!. This is so helpful in doing my yoga practice at home. Very calm and soothing. I highly recommend, as a yoga enthusiast, student and teacher. 💗
Ads at then end of yoga practice too loud. Why

I love this app. I’ve had this app for many years.
 I was a beginner when I first started. 
 It’s very instructional (explanatory) and tells you when to breathe and specifically how to get into each of the moves and she does it with you. 
It’s like having your own personal yoga teacher. 
I always feel at peace afterwards. 
I definitely would recommend it for anyone. I like the old version better maybe cause I’m used to watching the girl they had before, but they both are great. 
I wouldn't change anything about it.

Same thing for years !!!. Horrible app! I even paid money and no new yoga for years just the same all the time! I even paid for the workout app they have too and that was slightly better but still they never post anything new!!! Don’t waste your time on this!
Simply yoga. I love this app because it’s been so helpful to me and it’s been so useful for my flexibility in my body

Not bad.. I like the simplicity of the background view. Simply a woman completing poses as dictated by a voiced-over female in detailed description. That is nice as it tells you what parts of your body should be doing in each pose. There is no background music which I like to have playing during yoga. I suppose I could play my own.
Yoga. Really enjoyed this program!!!!!

Like the simplicity so far.. I’ve only done 2 sessions so far and definitely considering buying the pro version. I am mainly comparing this app to YouTube videos. I like that the app is straight to the point and I don’t have to hear about a sponsor. I like the audio cues and that can hear a bit of another app in the background. Wish it wouldn’t turn down the other app so that I could listen to a book at the same time. I feel like the sun salutation flow is a bit too fast. UI a little outdated but I can live with that. It did the same workout as the first time so I would like if there was a little list of available workouts. I will make a custom one for variety but would like if there were a few options to jump in with.

I can feel the blood flowing to the parts of my body that I know need it. I can definitely say that I’m a calmer driver because of it, and that has flowed into my everyday dealings with people.

I used it to help managed my stress and feel stronger before my wedding, after my baby was born and onwards. Definitely recommend for someone who wants strength, flexibility and calmness!

I also like the way you are able to choose the length of time you want. I enjoy the sound of the ocean in the background, especially while doing the corpse pose!

Loving it. I first started using Simply Yoga 10 years ago. Initially I just wanted it to help me get started on Yoga. I liked that the woman who was doing the poses wasn’t that super flexible 😎 Made me feel a lot better during my struggles to get the poses and flow right. Now 10 years later I still use the App 2-3 times per week. The “new” woman is slightly more flexible than the previous, but still makes even the harder poses look achievable.

Advertisement at end of yoga. LOVE Simply Yoga! 
I’m not sure if it’s possible, but I would prefer a more peaceful advertisement after my relaxing yoga. The advertisement that came on today was very loud and stimulating just after the yoga instructor had advised me to relax. Lol

Perfect for me. This provides the poses I like most for balance and flexibility. The 20 minute routine lets me find time to keep up my practice even on a busy day. My only complaint is about the sometimes noisy ads that follow closely after the end of the routine. Some ads continue the relaxing music, but others run loud discordant beats that shock you out of the mellow relaxing mood of the yoga routine . I don’t mind having ads. I can’t afford the ad-free subscription. I just wish you either delayed the noise or used more soothing music.

Renewed strength & flexibility!!!. Excellent for beginners, experienced, and advanced. Awesome way to begin and finish your day. 

I have a bad spine and this has given me, renewed strength and flexibility!!! It is the healing that I have been searching for!

Buy the app one time, no additional charges, no monthly fees. 

No regrets, just extreme gratitude and physical peace!!!

Not as I imagined. Hi, I was using Simply Yoga last year and loved the 20 minute version. The holidays came and I had no time to practice.

With the stay-at-home advisory during this Covid-19 pandemic, I decided to restart my Simply Yoga practice. While I appreciate the change in format, there is NO EASY FLOW of the 20 minute practice. She’s sitting, she’s standing...and the Sun Salutation is way too fast. I really like, within the 20 minute version, the new poses, however, no flow in getting to the next pose.
I do not want to upgrade to another version, I was totally happy with the older version. 
Just my 59 year old opinion.

Helpful visual reference to yoga newcomers.. This is a great visual tutorial, perfect for anyone who has never done yoga before and wants to learn some basic poses. There is a video of a woman doing the poses as well as a voiceover describing HOW to do them

Personally I think it’s a great idea to watch it all a few times to become familiar with the moves and how to do them. Then, when you start doing the workout the audio description helps you remember what you’re supposed to be doing so that you don’t have to keep looking back at the screen to see what you should be doing.
